Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
The proposal of Delhi Urban Art Commission (DUAC) regarding extension of deputation tenure of Shri Vinod Kumar, Secretary, DUAC has been considered in the Ministry
The President is pleased to appoint Dr. G. Narayana Raju, a permanent officer of the Indian Legal Service and at present working as Member

Cabinet Secretariat Resolution dated 1st January, 2015 and in continuation of Notification dated 7th January, 2015, the Prime Minister has approved the appointment of Prof. Ramesh Chand as Full-time Member in the NITI Aayog
President is pleased to accept the resignation of Shri L. Nageswara Rao from the post of Additional Solicitor General of India with effect from 20th July, 2015.

The President is pleased to appoint the following Joint Secretary and Legislative Counsels (Grade-I of Indian Legal Service) in the Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice as Additional Secretary in the Legislative Department.

Shri Sushil Kumar, has joined the Central Information Commission on the forenoon of 01.08.2014. Shri Sushil Kumar, Under Secretary, is taken on the strength of Central Information Commission w.e.f. 01.08.2014.

The President is pleased to appoint Shri Kaushik Chanda, Senior Advocate as Additional Solicitor General of India in the High Court of Calcutta for a period of three years with effect from 09th April, 2015.

The President is pleased to appoint Shri Satya Pal Jain, Senior Advocate as Additional Solicitor General of India in the High Court of Punjab and Haryana at Chandigarh for a period of three years with effect from 8th April, 2015.

The President is pleased to appoint Shri Satya Darshi Sanjay, Senior Advocate as Additional Solicitor General of India in the High Court of Judicature at Patna for a period of three years with effect from 08th April, 2015.

The President is pleased to appoint Shri Prabhuling K. Navadgi, Senior Advocate as Additional Solicitor General of India in the High Court of Karnataka for a period of three years with effect from 08th April, 2015.
The President is pleased to appoint Shri K. M. Nataraj, Senior Advocate as Additional Solicitor General of India for Southern Zone for a period of three years with effect from 08th April, 2015.

The President, on the advice of the Prime Minister, has been pleased to relinquish Shri Raosaheb Dadarao Danve from the charge of the office of the Minister of State in the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution with effect from 5th March, 2015.
The President is pleased to appoint Shri Rajendra Madhukar Palhade, Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Mumbai to the post of Registrar.

The Central Govt. is pleased to appoint Mr. Justice Dev Darshan Sud, Retired Judge, High Court of Himachal Pradesh, as President of the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal, with effect from the forenoon of 12th March, 2015.
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways

The Central Govt. hereby entrusts additional charge of the post of Dy. Chairman, Mumbai Port Trust to Shri Neeraj Bansal (IRS: 94), Dy. Chairman, Jawaharlal Nehru Port Trust from 9th October, 2014 till a regular Dy. Chairman is appointed in Mumbai Port Trust or until further orders.
